review_actions.action: Review identical-cloud groups spanning split-named folders. Folder names are hints, not a certified benchmark protocol.
Review connected source/derivative identities; keep each accepted identity in one split. Do not choose a canonical copy automatically.
Resolve physical sites/captures before certifying site-out evaluation.
Define a task-specific split protocol after identity and site review.
Verify units, CRS and height reference before spatial alignment; never infer them from bounds alone.
Keep deferred derivatives blocked until intended-use rights are reviewed.

scope.limits: Hashes are recorded evidence, not current payload verification. No near-duplicate geometry, annotation correctness, full license review or automatic deletion. This report does not authorize execution.
